# Jeffrin James

> Product designer in Bengaluru, India, currently at JioMart (Reliance Retail), designing across enterprise, consumer and seller-facing commerce products.

## Case studies
- [The Product Rating That Was Lying To Everyone](https://jeffrinjames.co/work/product-rating/): How we untangled JioMart's feedback flow so customers stopped punishing products for a delivery they never controlled
- [One Item Away!](https://jeffrinjames.co/work/one-item-away/): How a cart progress bar turned average order value into a goal shoppers wanted to reach, not a number we pushed them to hit
- [Behavioural System Design & Gamification of iAspire](https://jeffrinjames.co/work/iaspire/): An early-career product design project that shaped my thought about behavioural design and human psychology.
- [Enabling Seller-Funded Coupons in JioMart](https://jeffrinjames.co/work/seller-coupons/): Led product design of a self-serve coupon system that built seller trust and let sellers start and fund their own campaigns
